title: UP brahmin vote up for grabs? How Akhilesh is manoeuvring his 'PDA' politics
content: Akhilesh Yadav is strategically extending his political outreach to Brahmins in preparation for the 2027 elections. He asserts that this community has suffered greatly under the current regime. This initiative seeks to enlarge his political coalition, moving beyond his usual support base. Mayawati rebuts this tactic, labeling it as political trickery. The Brahmin vote is crucial, drawing attention from various political factions.

title: 'Shiva puja' performed at ASI-protected Mehtab Bagh near Taj Mahal
content: The Archaeological Survey of India has lodged a police complaint following a religious ceremony conducted by unidentified individuals at the Mehtab Bagh complex, which is situated north of the Taj Mahal. Footage captured the participants worshipping Lord Shiva and displaying a religious flag. Authorities have pointed fingers at suspected members of the Akhil Bharat Hindu Mahasabha. An FIR has been filed, and investigations are in progress to locate those responsible.

title: MGNREGA out, VB-G RAM G in: What changes for rural jobs, workers and states
content: MGNREGA has been replaced by VB-G RAM G, increasing guaranteed employment days.  The new scheme features a revised funding structure and allocation framework for rural India.  States will now share program costs with the Centre in a 60:40 ratio.  This transition aims to create durable assets and link wage work with village infrastructure.  Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra are projected to be significant beneficiaries of this new program.

title: Apple shareholder since IPO in 1980 buys Ferrari’s first EV, designed by Jony Ive
content: Florida billionaire Herbert Wertheim purchased the first production Ferrari Luce for forty million dollars. This groundbreaking electric vehicle was designed with input from former Apple design chief Jony Ive.  The unique car, known as Chassis Zero, fetched an astonishing price at auction.  Wertheim, a long-time Apple shareholder, acquired the vehicle at an RM Sotheby's event.  The entire sale proceeds will benefit the Ferrari Foundation.

title: 1st Test: India on verge of massive win as Sri Lanka four down in chase of 372
content: India are on the brink of victory in the first Test against Sri Lanka, having pulled the hosts down to just 84 runs for four wickets. Rishabh Pant's explosive innings of 66 has paved the way for a challenging target. Sri Lanka now confronts a daunting task on the final day, as India's bowlers tighten their grip with critical wickets already claimed.

title: ‘PM CARES? Hardly’: Congress jabs govt for utilising only 0.01% of relief fund
content: Domestic donations to the PM CARES Fund fell by 30 per cent to nearly Rs 479 crore in the financial year 2024-25, while foreign donations declined by 18 per cent to Rs 92.8 lakh, according to the fund's latest audit report. The total balance in the PM CARES Fund stood at Rs 8,452 crore as on March 31, 2025, compared with Rs 7,173 crore a year earlier.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40B in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's donations have enabled medical debt abolition across America. Her approach allows acquiring and erasing patient debt at steep discounts. This model has inspired other billionaires to contribute millions to similar initiatives. While philanthropic efforts provide immediate relief, policy reform remains stalled. Lasting change may require systemic reforms addressing the root causes of medical debt.

title: US reservoir plan displaced 600 families; abandoned land became national park
content: The ambitious dam project planned for the Delaware River faced substantial backlash, resulting in its cancellation. This pivotal decision ultimately fostered the establishment of the Delaware Water Gap National Recreation Area, a refuge for the river's unspoiled segments. Factors such as environmental concerns and increasing financial burdens were significant in the cancellation, signaling a major milestone in US conservation efforts and land protection strategies.

title: American woman loves IKEA plates; Indians say they're basic steel thalis
content: An influencer recently stumbled upon stylish IKEA chrome plates priced at fifteen dollars, lauding their modern design. Meanwhile, Indian consumers were quick to point out that these plates resemble their everyday thali plates commonly found in households. This sparked a conversation about the stark price difference for something viewed as ordinary in one culture but trendy in another, emphasizing the deep-rooted cultural distinctions in everyday items.

title: Chinese AI lab Z.ai gets warning similar to top US AI companies
content: China's Z.ai lab has announced a two-week delay for the release of its GLM-5.3 AI model. This cutting-edge model demonstrates remarkable proficiency in detecting and exploiting security vulnerabilities. With its performance surpassing that of US models in key benchmarks, Z.ai positions GLM-5.3 as a critical tool for safeguarding open-source environments. However, post-release, managing its application effectively poses an ongoing concern.

title: Aaron Rodgers quietly shapes Steelers’ next generation before retiring
content: In his concluding NFL season, Aaron Rodgers is making a significant impact on the Pittsburgh Steelers by serving as a steadying influence. He is dedicating time to mentor young quarterbacks and has arranged offseason excursions aimed at strengthening bonds with his receivers. This proactive approach to veteran mentorship is essential for equipping the next crop of players while the Steelers aim for a season filled with purpose beyond mere wins.

title: Micah Parsons predicts 2026 AFC winners: Broncos, Patriots, Ravens and Texans
content: Micah Parsons has shared his valuable insights on potential AFC Divisional winners for 2026. He believes the Denver Broncos will secure the top position in the AFC West, edging out rivals Kansas City Chiefs. In the AFC East, the New England Patriots are his favorites to lead, while he anticipates the Baltimore Ravens clinching the AFC North.

title: Khamzat Chimaev sends bold UFC callout after Sean Strickland title loss
content: Khamzat Chimaev lost his middleweight title to Sean Strickland at UFC 328.  He now wants to move up to the light heavyweight division for new challenges.  Chimaev has directly messaged UFC CEO Dana White about his next opportunity.  The fighter is eager to compete again after his recent medical suspension.  His future UFC appearance might be at a different weight class.

title: ‘Colonial overlords’: Delhi court slams Gujarat cops for 'using' child to nab dad
content: In a significant ruling, a Delhi court dismissed the request of four Gujarat Police officers accused of exploiting a minor boy as bait. The court remarked that their conduct mirrored that of colonial rulers during the operation. Furthermore, it was determined that the officers had no legal justification to cross state lines with the child, leading to the affirmation of kidnapping charges against them.

title: Learn Marathi in 1 month or lose licence? New rules for auto, taxi drivers kick in
content: Auto and taxi drivers must now possess working Marathi knowledge starting 18 August.  Non-compliant drivers will receive a show-cause notice and one month to learn.  Failure to comply leads to a three-month license suspension and potential revocation.  Over one lakh certificates were prepared for drivers completing the basic Marathi course.  This initiative aims to improve communication between drivers and passengers across Maharashtra.

title: Quote of the day by Amanda Seyfried
content: Amanda Seyfried shared wisdom on ignoring hateful words from insecure people. She explained that cruel behavior often stems from personal dissatisfaction and fear. Seyfried's own career demonstrates perseverance despite public scrutiny and pressure. She now focuses on her personal life and farm away from Hollywood. The actress began her career young and has an extensive filmography.

title: After 1,800 km dash, reserves Surya-Pramuthesh endure golden point heartbreak
content: A surprise call-up turned a Karnataka State Championships exit into a World Championships debut for mixed doubles team Ashith Surya and Amrutha Pramuthesh. The Indian reserves flew 1,800 km to Delhi and pushed Turkey’s Emre Sonmez and Uasemen Bektas through a 73-minute thriller, losing despite seven match points. Their defeat featured the first golden point at the Worlds in 11 years.

title: ‘Enrol your kids in govt schools’: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke to ministers
content: Activist Abhijeet Dipke questioned why officials send their children to private schools. He believes government schools would improve if they had more confidence. Dipke's remarks followed his inspection of a government school in Santuk Pimpri. He found broken window panes and a lack of basic amenities there. The school principal was suspended after the activist's visit and complaints.

title: Surat restaurant shut after child dies, 3 hospitalised due to 'food poisoning'
content: A Surat restaurant faced closure after a child died and three others were hospitalized. Health officials found spoiled food items during an inspection of the establishment. These items included chana dal, vegetables, and exposed paneer which were destroyed. The affected family reportedly consumed food purchased from the restaurant on August 15. Further action will be taken against the owner under the Food Safety Act.

title: No Khel Ratna recommendation for 2025, 17 athletes get Arjuna Awards
content: In a surprising turn, India's prestigious Khel Ratna award will not have a recipient in 2025, marking this as the third time since its establishment in 1991-92. Meanwhile, the Arjuna Award will honor seventeen exceptional athletes for their achievements, while coaches are set to receive the Dronacharya Awards. Additionally, the Army Paralympic Node will be recognized with the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar for its significant contributions to sports.

title: Quarter of fleet downed, US still flying MQ-9s in combat; India awaits delivery
content: The US military has lost many MQ-9 Reaper drones in the ongoing conflict. These drones are vulnerable due to their slow speed and low-altitude flight. India is acquiring these drones for its military services in a significant deal. These unmanned aircraft are expected to be inducted into service by 2029. India will assemble many drones locally and source components from India.

title: Red Fort blast: HC denies default bail to ‘in-house engineer’ Jasir Wani
content: The Delhi high court denied default bail to Jasir Bilal Wani. Wani is an accused in the 2025 Red Fort car bomb blast case. The court dismissed his appeal challenging a trial court order. He was arrested in November 2025 for alleged terror attack support. The NIA chargesheet identified him as the module's in-house engineer.

title: ‘Protest hasn't ended’: Devendra Mahto announces 2nd phase of Jharkhand exam stir
content: Devendra Mahto ended his hunger strike after the Jharkhand government cancelled job examinations due to alleged irregularities. He announced a second phase of protest demanding corruption-free recruitment through JPSC and JSSC. The agitation will continue until the government guarantees no future paper leaks or irregularities. The government has formed an exam reforms committee to strengthen the recruitment process.

title: Govinda defends his long-standing late coming reputation
content: Govinda candidly reflected on the challenges of his rigorous shooting schedules, emphasizing the struggle to maintain punctuality amidst demanding multiple shifts. Filmmakers, eager for his participation, would often rearrange their schedules. He pointed out that co-stars received compensation for their waiting times on set. Govinda also fondly reminisced about his extensive collaborations with notable actors Kader Khan and Shakti Kapoor.

title: CCTV off, phone purged: Cops probe killing of child who saw dad’s murder
content: Police arrested Harini for allegedly killing her husband and son. She reportedly conspired with her lover, Vinay, to commit the murders. The child was allegedly strangled after witnessing his father's death. Investigators suspect property was a motive for the alleged double murder. Harini confessed to the killings during police interrogation.

title: 'We don't share girlfriends!': Inside the lives of badminton's sibling partnerships
content: At the BWF World Championships in Delhi, sibling partnerships offer more than a shared surname. Scotland’s identical Grimley twins have spent two decades learning each other’s game, while France’s Popov brothers see doubles as an escape from the pressures of singles. Czech siblings Ondrej and Jiri Kral, meanwhile, embrace the comfort, and occasional friction, of sharing life and badminton.

title: JSSC-CGL exam cancellation ends one protest, sparks another as 2,000 fear job loss
content: Successful JSSC-CGL candidates protested the Jharkhand government's decision to cancel recruitment exams.  They fear losing their government jobs after the cancellation announcement on Monday night.  Protesters demanded a CBI probe and an opportunity to defend themselves against allegations.  The government defended the cancellation to restore confidence in the recruitment system.  Fresh vacancies will provide opportunities for deserving candidates after reforms.

title: Goa night club fire: Bombay HC cancels bail of Luthra brothers and Ajay Gupta
content: The Bombay high court cancelled bail for three Birch by Romeo Lane co-owners. They must surrender within two weeks and can file fresh bail applications. The state challenged lower court bail orders in the fire and forgery cases. Investigations revealed the club lacked essential fire safety and had an illegal structure. The accused denied responsibility, blaming an event company for the fire.

title: Dia Mirza on co-stars: Recalls feeling safe with Madhavan; praises Salman, Bachchan
content: Dia Mirza opened up about her co-stars over two decades. She called Jimmy Sheirgill "ever-evolving," recalled feeling safe with R Madhavan during her debut at 19, praised Amitabh Bachchan's discipline, and called Salman Khan "the most generous" person she's worked with. She was last seen in Operation Safed Sagar.

title: Why Manhattan’s Flatiron Building is suddenly one of its hottest luxury addresses
content: New York's Flatiron Building is becoming a sought-after luxury residential address. Most apartments are already under contract as the landmark prepares for resident move-ins. A $24 million apartment recently entered contract, highlighting strong buyer interest. The century-old building is undergoing a significant conversion from offices to upscale homes. Residents will enjoy modern amenities after the building's completion this autumn.

title: David Warner convicted of drink-driving; Big Bash captaincy under cloud
content: On Easter Sunday, David Warner, ex-Australian cricketer, was penalised and ordered to install an interlock device after being convicted of mid-range drink-driving during a random breath test. The court acknowledged the significant media attention and economic consequences he might face. However, the judge highlighted the critical aspect of deterrence with children present in the vehicle.

title: No chemistry teacher: Gen alpha students protest at Azamgarh school
content: Students protested their Azamgarh college, citing excessive fees and teacher shortages. They demanded a chemistry teacher, receiving assurances of one within forty-eight hours. Allegations of unreturned funds and management issues were also raised by supporters. The students seek fair treatment and better academic facilities from the institution. They warned of renewed protests if the chemistry teacher is not provided promptly.

title: Banks closed tomorrow: Why branches will remain shut in Tripura on August 19
content: On August 19, banks across Tripura will be closed in observance of a regional holiday. Other states will also experience bank holidays later this month to honor various festivals. While branch operations will be halted, digital banking services will continue to function normally. Customers should adjust their plans accordingly to account for these closures while still being able to access online and ATM banking throughout the holidays.

title: ‘He quit his job’: Unnati’s emotional tribute to father after World C'ships debut win
content: Making a remarkable debut at the BWF World Championships, Unnati Hooda scored a swift victory in straight games. She expressed heartfelt thanks to her father, who sacrificed his career to coach her diligently. Inspired by Ayush Shetty's surprising triumph over a top competitor, Unnati is determined to focus on her performance and give her best throughout the tournament.

title: Indore student fails JEE twice, builds Rs 2 lakh freelance career; Warikoo reacts
content: Ankur Warikoo’s post about an Indore-based designer who failed JEE twice before building a successful freelance career has sparked debate over India’s obsession with educational credentials. While Warikoo argues that talent often remains hidden behind college labels, critics say such success stories are exceptions. The discussion highlights the need to assess ability beyond degrees and prestigious institutions.

title: Rishabh Pant creates history, becomes first Indian to achieve this feat
content: India's star wicketkeeper batter Rishabh Pant created history on Tuesday during the first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle. The India wicketkeeper-batter became the first Indian cricketer to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket. Pant reached the milestone with a big six off Lahiru Kumara. The shot also brought up his 20th Test fifty.

title: Russia warns UK over Ukraine drone supplies, says Britain will face ‘consequences’
content: ANI Russia warns Britain it will pay a 'price' for its support for Ukraine . embassy in London accuses the country of 'deliberately opting for an escalation' the warning follows reports in the Times and Sunday Times that British-made drones had been used by Ukraine in long-range strikes .

title: PM CARES Fund data made public; balance rises to Rs 8,452 crore
content: the PM CARES Fund recorded total receipts of Rs 8,452.95 crore in the financial year 2024-25 . fixed deposits accounted for nearly 93 per cent of the fund's closing balance . interest earned from these fixed deposits stood at Rs 469.38 crore .

title: 'Will form high-powered panel': SC on Delhi Police 'excesses' against student protesters
content: the bench will pass the order on Wednesday after receiving suggestions from the parties on other members to be included in the panel . the bench also said it will direct the authorities to hand over video footage and CCTV recordings of the violence during the July 20 Parliament march in Delhi .

title: 'Move Imran Khan to hospital': Pakistan SC directs govt amid ex-PM's health concerns
content: imran Khan, 73, has been in jail since august 2023 after being convicted in several cases that he and his supporters have described as politically motivated . his party welcomed the court order, saying it should have come earlier . he should remain in hospital until all doctors are satisfied .
